# N7: Help and what’s new: reachable everywhere, searchable, opened for the page you’re on, and an unread dot that clears

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/7-help.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

Help and what's new. [HELP-GUIDE] Help is reachable from the sidebar (desktop), the icon rail (tablet) and More (phone); its search finds articles; the Help link at the foot of a page opens that page's article; the pages don't scroll sideways, read at a readable width and have no serious accessibility problems. [WHATS-NEW] A release you haven't seen puts a quiet dot beside Help (and on More) and one line on Home that doesn't push the week's main action out of the first screen; opening What's new clears both, and they stay cleared after a reload; dismissing the line on Home does the same.
